note: The scorer the blind-set lock names. score.mjs compares its own content hash with contentHash, refuses a scored run when they differ, and says in every report whether they match. This file is not part of the content hash.
contentHashRule: sha256 over eval/fresh/*.mjs and eval/fresh/*.py, sorted by file name, each as its name, a zero byte, its bytes and a zero byte
gateConfigurations: gate-empty: identifiers profile, empty people map
gate-header: identifiers profile, people map from the document's header block (eval/fresh/header-map.mjs, version 1)
baselines: remove-every-word: replaces every run of letters and digits

presidio: presidio-analyzer 2.2.360, presidio-anonymizer 2.2.360, spacy 3.8.7, en_core_web_lg 3.8.0, Python 3.9.6, default English recognizers, no score threshold, run offline under sandbox-exec with network access denied (eval/fresh/presidio-requirements.txt)
